correctness.rationale: Exact parallel firing recurrence on the specified nine-vertex rose has complete repeated-state certificates for every h. The maximal firing-set nerves are homotopy equivalent to the avalanche complexes by the good-cover nerve lemma. Deterministic elementary simplicial collapses leave a triangle cycle for h=0 and a point for h=2,3. For h=1 the surviving 39-face complex admits an explicitly verified acyclic matching with exactly one vertex and two critical 2-cells, proving the integral S^2 wedge. Independent direct and nerve mod-two boundary reductions corroborate, but do not replace, the homotopy proof.

value.rationale: The motivating primary paper expressly highlights asymmetric cyclic bouquets as an open source of richer topology. Holding the nine-vertex directed rose and six-chip budget fixed while moving one vacancy gives a complete natural four-position classification with three qualitatively distinct integral homotopy types, including a two-sphere wedge absent in the synchronized case. The exact acyclic Morse certificate resolves a genuine homotopy question, not just a numeric graph statistic; no generalization beyond the specified class is claimed.
